props.subTitle: Heavy legs, hot days
props.title: Why Guests Book a Lymphatic Massage in Seminyak
props.text: It's often booked after a long flight, on hot, humid days when legs feel heavy, or after a few active days of surfing, walking and sightseeing. Many guests find their legs and ankles feel lighter afterwards, though the effect is temporary; others simply want a quiet massage with no firm pressure. Guests book it for:

Legs that feel puffy in the heat
featuresRight: Tired legs after surfing or a day of walking

props.subTitle: Check with a doctor first
props.title: When Not to Book a Lymphatic Drainage Massage
props.text: Lymphatic drainage massage is gentle, but it isn't right for everyone. If any of these apply to you, check with your doctor before booking, and only book once they've said it's fine. If you're not sure, ask us on WhatsApp first. It is a relaxation treatment, not a medical one.
featuresLeft: A fever, an infection or feeling unwell
A painful, red or swollen leg (a possible blood clot)
featuresRight: Recent surgery, until your surgeon has cleared you

props.imageAlt: Therapist's hands on a guest's abdomen during a lymphatic massage
props.subTitle: From the first chat to the last stroke
props.title: Your Lymphatic Massage, Step by Step
props.text: Every session follows the same order. It starts with a short chat about how you feel, any health conditions and the areas you would like focused on, and we give you a clean towel or spa wear. Your therapist then applies a little oil and begins at the neck and collarbone, working down the body one area at a time, with every stroke moving toward the nearest lymph nodes. The hand strokes stay very light, because lymph vessels sit just under the skin; a longer session adds time, not pressure. The usual order is:
featuresLeft: A short chat about how you feel
featuresRight: Upper legs, then calves and ankles

props.subTitle: Brought in when needed
props.title: Wood Therapy with Your Lymphatic Massage
props.text: Alongside the light hand strokes of manual lymphatic drainage, our therapists bring in wood therapy when needed. Wood therapy uses smooth, hand-held wooden tools, shaped to follow the curves of the body, in place of the hands for some strokes. If you have questions about it, or would like to know whether it suits you, ask us when you book on WhatsApp.
featuresRight: Ask us about it when you book

props.subTitle: Frequently Asked Questions
props.title: About Lymphatic Drainage Massage in Seminyak

items.question: How much does a lymphatic drainage massage cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: At our Seminyak spa, a lymphatic drainage massage costs IDR 300.000 for 1 hour, IDR 440.000 for 1.5 hours and IDR 580.000 for 2 hours, per person. Home service at your villa or hotel adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area. Booking is by WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144, 9am to 11pm.

items.question: How long is a lymphatic massage, and which length should I choose?
items.answer: Sessions are 1, 1.5 or 2 hours. One hour (IDR 300.000) suits a first session or mild heaviness after travel. With 1.5 hours (IDR 440.000) or 2 hours (IDR 580.000), your therapist has more time across the whole body, with extra time for the legs and ankles. Every session uses the same gentle technique.

items.question: Where can I get a lymphatic drainage massage in Seminyak?
items.answer: Spa Bali Moon offers lymphatic drainage massage at our spa on Jl. Pangkung Sari No. 30, Seminyak, or at your villa or hotel for an extra IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area. Book by WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144; we are open daily from 9am to 11pm.

items.question: Do your therapists specialise in lymphatic drainage?
items.answer: Yes. Our therapists all specialise in manual lymphatic drainage (MLD), the slow, very light technique used in every session, and lymphatic drainage massage is our most booked treatment. When needed, they also bring in wooden tools (wood therapy).

items.question: Do you use wood therapy in a lymphatic massage?
items.answer: Yes, when needed. Alongside the light hand strokes, our therapists bring in wood therapy: smooth, hand-held wooden tools used for some of the strokes. Ask us about it when you book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144.

items.question: Should I book a lymphatic or a deep tissue massage?
items.answer: It depends on how your body feels. A [deep tissue massage](/seminyak/deep-tissue-massage/) uses firm pressure on tight muscles, from IDR 269.000 for 1 hour. Lymphatic drainage massage uses very light, rhythmic strokes along the lymph pathways and suits legs and ankles that feel heavy or puffy, from IDR 300.000 for 1 hour. If you are unsure, tell us how you feel when you book and we can help you choose.

items.question: Can I have a lymphatic drainage massage after liposuction or other surgery?
items.answer: Yes, once your surgeon has cleared you for it. Spa Bali Moon offers lymphatic drainage massage for recovery after cosmetic surgery such as liposuction or a tummy tuck, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel. Tell us the procedure and its date when you book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144; your therapist uses only very light strokes and keeps away from incisions.

items.question: Can I have a lymphatic drainage massage at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. A Spa Bali Moon therapist comes from our Seminyak spa to your villa, hotel or home with fresh linen, oils and everything a lymphatic drainage massage needs. It costs the same as at the spa, plus a home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist in Seminyak, Petitenget and Kerobokan, or IDR 150.000 in Canggu, North Kuta and Kuta. Book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144, 9am to 11pm.

items.question: Can I book a lymphatic drainage massage for today?
items.answer: Often, yes, depending on availability. Message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 between 9am and 11pm with the time you'd like. At our Seminyak spa we confirm the next free time; at a villa or hotel in the Seminyak area a therapist usually arrives within 30 to 60 minutes. For a set time, or for two or more guests, book earlier in the day.

items.question: Can two of us book a lymphatic massage at the same time?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us how many guests and which treatments when you book on WhatsApp, and we will confirm a time when enough therapists are free, at our spa or at your villa or hotel. For two or more guests, book earlier in the day.

items.question: What should I wear for a lymphatic massage?
items.answer: We give you a clean towel or spa wear before your session. Only the area being massaged is uncovered, so you stay covered and comfortable throughout. A little massage oil is used.

items.question: Is there anything to do before or after a lymphatic massage?
items.answer: Before: tell us about any health condition, recent surgery or pregnancy when you book, and again in the short chat before your session. After: drink water and rest; some people feel tired, thirsty or slightly light-headed after a lymphatic massage.

items.question: Can I combine a lymphatic massage with other treatments?
items.answer: Yes. Our Lymphatic & Gold Facial special pairs a 1-hour lymphatic massage with the 1-hour Bali Moon Gold Facial for IDR 525.000 per person (IDR 569.000 booked separately). Many guests also add foot reflexology or a body treatment to the same visit. Tell us which treatments you would like when you book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144.

items.question: Can I have lymphatic drainage on my face?
items.answer: Yes, as part of the 1-hour [Bali Moon Facial](/seminyak/facial/), which includes an argan oil lymphatic facial massage. Our lymphatic drainage massage itself works on the body, from the neck and collarbone down.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist for my lymphatic drainage massage?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your lymphatic drainage massage on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.

items.question: What if I need to cancel or change my booking?
items.answer: You can cancel or reschedule up to 12 hours before your appointment at no charge. A cancellation within 12 hours is charged 50%, and a no-show the full treatment price or the deposit. See our [terms and conditions](/terms-and-conditions/).
